issues.claim: legal_privacy[1] (NJ notice for silent video): 'silent video falls outside the wiretap act' carried under confirmed: true with the Brach Eichler URL
issues.problem: The Brach Eichler page does support the two main points (no NJ statute/regulation governing employer video use in the workplace; common-law intrusion upon seclusion; handbook notice; stay out of restrooms/break rooms), but it never mentions the Wiretap Act or silent video. The 'outside the wiretap act' half is inference, not from that source. I confirmed separately that N.J.S.A. 2A:156A-3 keys on interception of a 'wire, electronic or oral communication', so the inference is sound - it is just not sourced to the cited page.
issues.fix: Split the entry: keep 'no NJ statute governs employer video; intrusion tort applies' as confirmed to Brach Eichler, and either cite 2A:156A-3 for the audio-only reading of the wiretap act or mark that half as inference.

issues.claim: existing_solutions: PalletVision is 'A wrap-station/outbound product for shippers and 3PLs, not an inbound PO-reconciliation tool.'
issues.problem: The wrap-station/outbound facts and the 'shippers and 3PLs' audience are confirmed on palletvision.com, but 'not an inbound PO-reconciliation tool' is a positioning inference stated as fact, without an inference label.
issues.fix: Phrase as 'page describes only wrap-station capture and pallet records; no inbound PO/ASN reconciliation is described (inference)'.

issues.claim: technical_approach: SCD has '10k+ annotated stacking scenes'
issues.problem: True but understated. The arXiv abstract reports 16,136 images and 250,000 instance masks.
issues.fix: Use the published figures (16,136 images / 250k instance masks) so the dataset's scale is stated as the source states it.

issues.claim: measured_outcomes: YOLOv12 damaged-parcel study rated strength 'Medium'
issues.problem: Not a FAIL - vendor claims are correctly Low and nothing is rated High. But this is a single 5,188-image dataset with a ~7% test split and no field deployment; 'Medium' is at the top of what the evidence supports.
issues.fix: Optional: keep Medium but add 'single dataset, small test split, no field deployment' to the sample field (the split detail is already there) and avoid citing it as a dock-readiness number in the pitch.
